outputs.explanation: Body weight, LW/BW, and FW/BW are shown as scatter plots with individual mouse data points (circles for NC, squares for HFD) plotted alongside mean ± S.D. bars.
Panel B shows representative gross (macroscopic) photographs of mice, not a plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C shows representative H&E and Oil Red O micrograph images, not a quantitative plot, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel D shows a dot blot (5mC) and methylene blue staining image, which are blot-type images, not a plot of averaged data.
The 5mC/Methylene Blue quantification is shown as a bar chart with individual sample data points (circles and squares) overlaid on the bars.

Panel F contains western blot images (TET1, TET2, TET3, GAPDH) plus a bar chart quantification below; the bar chart displays individual data points (circles for NC, squares for HFD) overlaid on the mean ± S.E.M. bars.
